en.hubeali: From him, from Ibn Mahboub, from Abdullah Bin Sinan who said,
‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about the woad (a dyeing plant), so he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘There is no problem with it for the old man, the aged’.
en.sarwar: 2. It is narrated from the narrator of the previous Hadith from ibn Mahbub from ‘Abd Allah ibn Sinan who has said the following: “
I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about applying Woad. He (the Imam) said, ‘It is not harmful to an old man ."
